items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I did a couple of things with him at Birdland... It was Panama and Roy Gaines, Milt Buckner and myself. Yeah. It was four of us.

ctx.x: Yeah, I did a couple of things with him at Birdland. Yeah, umhum. And he played with Hamp for many years. He was a fine arranger and played...you know he created the lock-hand style piano...which George Shearing incorporated, you know. And then he played marvelous vibes. He was a tremendous musician, yeah. I learned a lot from him.
Just thinking of that trip to Europe quickly, you were with Panama Francis?
Ah, it was Panama and Roy Gaines, Milt Buckner and myself. Yeah. It was four of us.
